description: Read one published country ranking by the slug of its https://statorigin.org/rankings/{slug} page. Example: crude-steel-production-by-country. Returns the comparable period and at most 20 rows. Each row has rank, value, unit, region, publisher, statistic id, and canonical url. If scan_capped is true, open the ranking URL for the complete table. Read-only: it does not invent a ranking the site does not publish.
name: get_ranking
title: Get a country ranking
